mechanism: Torsemide may reduce renal clearance of leflunomide's active metabolite (teriflunomide) through volume depletion and altered renal hemodynamics, potentially increasing teriflunomide accumulation and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function, blood pressure, and leflunomide tolerability; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative diuretics if loop diuretics are necessary; baseline and periodic monitoring of hepatic function and CBC is advisable.
